description: Implement the data contract as specified in section 4 of 実装指示プロンプト.md. Replace existing shared-types with the new manifest.json schema, S3 layout, and runtime validation. Create docs/contract.md. This is Task #1 from the spec.
steps: Read 実装指示プロンプト.md sections 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 carefully for the exact schema

Rewrite packages/shared-types/src/ to define: Manifest type matching section 4.2 exactly (schemaVersion, projectId, userId, contentLanguage, source, voice, output, lexicon, pages, stages, cost). Include all sub-types: source.kind ('generated'|'uploaded'), script.mode ('plain'|'ssml'), lexicon[].method ('sub'|'phoneme'|'spell'), stages values ('pending'|'running'|'done'|'failed'), output.aspect ('16:9'|'9:16'|'1:1'|'4:5'), output.captions ('burn'|'srt'|'none')

Add runtime validation using zod or manual validators that enforce all invariants from section 4.3: pages.length === source.pageCount, all script.text non-empty before audio stage, audioDurationSec only from ffprobe measurement
Add S3 key builder functions matching the layout in section 4.1: users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/input/, deck/, pages/, audio/, captions/, clips/, output/{renderId}/
Update packages/shared-types/package.json to add zod as a dependency if using zod for validation
Add comprehensive unit tests that verify: valid manifests pass, invalid manifests are rejected (wrong pageCount, empty script, missing required fields, invalid enum values)
Create docs/contract.md documenting the data contract with the S3 layout, manifest schema, and invariants
Update packages/shared-types/src/index.ts to export all new types and validators
Ensure pnpm build succeeds for packages/shared-types
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared-types exports a Manifest type matching section 4.2 exactly
Runtime validation rejects manifests where pages.length !== source.pageCount
Runtime validation rejects manifests where any script.text is empty
S3 key builders produce paths matching section 4.1 layout
docs/contract.md exists and documents the schema
Unit tests pass covering valid and invalid manifest cases
findings: All 46 tests pass. Build succeeds. zod 3.25.76 used for runtime validation. Other packages that import from shared-types will break (expected per plan). vitest.config.ts added with CJS Vite deprecation warning (cosmetic only, tests pass). The package uses CJS output (module: Node16) consistent with root tsconfig.
